title: Notification "Mark done" action
lead: Pulled into 1.0 by the owner. Yes/no reminders get a "Mark done" action and count reminders get a "+1" action. Measurement reminders keep tap-to-open only, because a value has to be typed.
findings_note: ReminderScheduler.kt:62-86 (notification has a content intent only, no actions)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A reminder can only open the app. Logging a yes/no or a single count from the notification saves a launch for the most common reminder response.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ReminderScheduler.kt`
- `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`
- `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml`
- `app/src/test/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ReminderSchedulerTest.kt` or a new `ReminderActionTest.kt`
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `fastlane/metadata/android/en-US/changelogs/10000.txt` if it lists features

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM, for a pure `reminderAction(type: TrackerType): ReminderAction?`:
- `yes_no gets mark done`
- `count gets plus one`
- `measure gets no action`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Add a pure `reminderAction(type)` returning `MARK_DONE` for `YES_NO`, `ADD_ONE` for `COUNT` and `null` for `MEASURE`.
2. Pass the tracker type to `showNotification`. When the action is not null, add one `NotificationCompat.Action` whose `PendingIntent.getBroadcast` targets a new `ReminderActionReceiver`, with `EXTRA_TRACKER_ID`, request code `trackerId.toInt()`, and `FLAG_IMMUTABLE or FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT`. Labels come from new string resources ("Mark done", "+1" with a content description such as "Add 1").
3. Register `ReminderActionReceiver` in the manifest with `android:exported="false"`.
4. In the receiver, use `goAsync()` and `Dispatchers.IO` with `try/finally` around `pendingResult.finish()`, as `ReminderReceiver` does. Load the bundle by id. If it is missing, archived, or `MEASURE`, cancel the notification and stop. Otherwise call `repository.addEntry(id, type, EntryDraft(LocalDate.now(), 1.0, null))`; `YES_NO` is already idempotent per date. Then cancel the notification with `NotificationManagerCompat.cancel(trackerId.toInt())`.
5. Do not open the activity. The dashboard updates through its existing Room flow when the app is open.
6. Add the action to the 1.0.0 entry in `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` and `./gradlew lintDebug` pass.
- Manual, on the emulator: a yes/no reminder 2 minutes out shows "Mark done". Tapping it logs today, dismisses the notification and the app does not open. The dashboard shows the tracker done.
- A count reminder shows "+1". Tapping it adds one entry of 1. A measurement reminder shows no action. Tapping the notification body still opens the tracker (S37).
- Tapping "Mark done" for a tracker already logged today adds no second entry.
- Re-walk the S22 reminder and notification gate rows in `DEVELOPERS.md` on the release APK.
